newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kesko 96 sales up 36.9 pct to FIM 37.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kesko 96 sales up 36.9 pct to FIM 37.2 bln.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said on Friday its sales excluding value-added-tax rose 36.9 percent year-on-year in 1996 to 37.2 billion markka.
Kesko's domestic sales excluding Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat acquired in 1996 rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in 1996 to 25.7 billion markka.
In December, Kesko's sales rose 65.4 percent year-on-year to 3.8 billion markka, and its domestic sales without the impact of Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat rose 4.2 percent to 2.3 billion markka.
